entries.1d35b10e4db22bbc: This business manufactures and sells optical semiconductor devices. It handles silicon photodiodes for X-ray CT, image sensors for semiconductor manufacturing and inspection equipment, flat panel sensors for dental diagnostic equipment, and other products. The company and Fairchild Imaging, Inc. of the United States manufacture these products, which are sold through domestic and overseas sales subsidiaries. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥79,505 million, the largest of the reportable segments.

entries.c11602ea0be6be6f: This business manufactures and sells photomultiplier tubes, image devices, and light sources. It handles photomultiplier tubes for specimen testing equipment, deuterium lamps for analytical instruments such as liquid chromatographs, microfocus X-ray sources for non-destructive inspection equipment for lithium-ion batteries, and other products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥71,906 million.
entries.c4e6e11f59f5ec1f: This business manufactures and sells laser equipment and laser equipment components. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥22,255 million, a substantial increase of 107.7% from the previous year.

Its growth strategy calls for growth in existing markets where it can leverage its strengths, growth through new business models, growth in new markets by leveraging the combined capabilities of the group, including technologies of NKT Photonics A/S and Fairchild Imaging, Inc., and establishment of new markets based on research results from its Central Research Laboratory.
